name: Bond
summary: A work assistant that reads connected tools and keeps one prioritized to-do list of commitments, drafting follow-ups and briefs for the person to send.

sources.title: Bond pricing, plans and frequently asked questions
Launch YC: BOND, AI Chief of Staff for CEOs and busy execs

claims.value: Pulls commitments out of connected work tools into one self-updating to-do list ranked P0–P3, with a morning brief and per-meeting context briefs
Reads and writes through connected app integrations; no control of your computer or of a cloud desktop is described
Researches meeting context from connected tools; interactive browser control is not specified
Ingests notes from connected meeting recorders such as Granola, Fireflies, Fathom, Circleback and Read AI; its own voice interface or ambient listening is not specified
claims.shortValue: Meeting-recorder notes; no own voice mode

claims.value: Runs a daily morning brief, prepares briefs ahead of meetings, tracks overdue commitments owed by others, and runs custom routines on a daily, weekly or monthly cycle
No native desktop app; the product states there is no new app to learn and runs in Slack and the web application
No native iPhone or Android app; mobile access is through iMessage and Slack
No public API is specified; Enterprise lists custom integrations and deployment options arranged with the team
Third-party AI model providers under zero-data-retention agreements; the specific models and providers are not named
Fully managed service; personal model keys or model selection are not specified
claims.shortValue: Included models; no BYO keys specified

claims.value: Standalone Bond individual or Enterprise subscription
Free tier with 10,000 credits; individual plan US$49/month; Enterprise priced on request
Provider-hosted service that connects to the user's third-party work accounts
Drafts follow-ups, replies and briefs and leaves sending to the person; the product describes the user staying in control of what gets sent
Builds lasting company context from documents, messages and decisions in connected tools; each person keeps their own context and to-do list
Everything can be exported, and data is deleted within 30 days of cancellation

Zero-data-retention agreements with model providers and no training on customer data; encrypted in transit and at rest; continuously monitored against ISO 27001 controls through Aikido Security. SOC 2 Type II, SSO, SCIM and audit logs are listed under Enterprise
claims.shortValue: Zero retention; no training; ISO 27001 monitoring

claims.value: Public sign-up with a free credit allowance; Enterprise access is arranged with the team

platforms.detail: Web application at app.bondapp.io, with Google, Microsoft or work-email sign-in
